problem: Kitchen sink leaking from beneath the cabinet
likely_cause: Drain pipe loose connection or P-trap seal failure
safety_note: Turn off water supply valve under sink before repair

likely_cause: Worn washer or cartridge inside the tap
safety_note: Turn off water supply before repair

likely_cause: Float ball adjustment needed or flapper valve worn out
Circuit overload or short circuit somewhere on the circuit
safety_note: Do not reset breaker multiple times. Call electrician immediately.

likely_cause: Loose wiring or worn-out switch contacts
safety_note: Turn off the circuit from the breaker panel. Do NOT use the switch.

problem: AC running but not cooling the room
likely_cause: Low refrigerant gas, dirty filter, or compressor issue
safety_note: Do not attempt to add refrigerant yourself - requires specialist equipment

problem: Water dripping from indoor AC unit
likely_cause: Clogged drain pipe or tilted indoor unit
safety_note: Place a bucket under the unit until repaired to avoid floor damage

likely_cause: Door latch issue, power supply problem, or motor fault
